say:0:1310502001:0.text: This was one of the battlefronts of the First Divine War, where countless warriors found their eternal rest.
say:0:1310502001:0.source_cn: 那里曾是恶魔战争的一处战场，有许多勇士埋骨泥下。

say:1:1310502002:0.text: Afterwards, flowers began to bloom abundantly, and don't even wither in the winter.
say:1:1310502002:0.source_cn: 战争结束后，那里突然长满了鲜花，即便冬季也从不衰败。

say:2:1310502003:0.text: It is as if the spirits of those heroes are truly enshrined within these blossoms...
say:2:1310502003:0.source_cn: 或许真有英雄的灵魂寄托在那些花中吧……

say:0:1310503001:0.text: Do you think we can really find a seven-petaled sapphirine blossom?
say:0:1310503001:0.source_cn: 真的能找到七瓣的蓝绒花吗？

say:1:1310503002:0.text: Magister is the "Chosen One", he'll definitely find it!
say:1:1310503002:0.source_cn: 主人是“受选者”，肯定没问题的！
say:1:1310503002:0.male: Magister is the "Chosen One", he'll definitely find it!
say:1:1310503002:0.female: Magister is the "Chosen One", she'll definitely find it!

say:0:1310504001:0.text: Wow! There are such beautiful flowers even in winter!
say:0:1310504001:0.source_cn: 哇，没想到冬天还会有这么漂亮的花海！

say:1:1310504002:0.text: There are so many flowers! Let's see if we can find a seven-petaled one.
say:1:1310504002:0.source_cn: 好多蓝绒花呀，快找找看有没有七瓣的。

say:0:1310505001:0.text: Not this one... not that one either...

say:1:1310505002:0.source_cn: 再找找看，满满就不信找不到！

say:1:1310506002:0.text: Searching for flowers aimlessly is so inefficient!
say:1:1310506002:0.source_cn: 这样漫无目的地找花，效率太低了！

say:2:1310506003:0.text: Perhaps you can consult the local residents.
say:2:1310506003:0.source_cn: 或许可以问问这附近的居民。

say:0:1310507001:0.text: The site of the lighting ceremony lies just east of this intersection.
say:0:1310507001:0.source_cn: 这个路口往东就是点火仪式会场。

say:1:1310507002:0.text: Everyone, I must attend to my duties and patrol the area. I shall reconvene with you later.
say:1:1310507002:0.source_cn: 诸位，我得去会场附近巡视了，稍后再见。

say:1:1310508001:0.text: Hello, Sir. Could we take a moment of your time?
say:1:1310508001:0.source_cn: 你好，这位先生，我们能占用你一些时间吗？

say:2:1310508002:0.text: Go away! I don't believe in any gods except Dura!
say:2:1310508002:0.source_cn: 走开走开，除了艾雅，我哪个神都不信！

say:3:1310508003:0.text: Huh? We just wanted to ask a question...
say:3:1310508003:0.source_cn: 啊？我们……只是想问个问题……

say:4:1310508004:0.text: What? You're... not here to preach? I'm so tired of hearing about the "Supreme Deity" recently...
say:4:1310508004:0.source_cn: 嗐……你们不是传教的啊！实在对不住，最近总是有人来说什...

say:5:1310508005:0.text: So what did you wanna ask about?

choice_prompt:6:1310508005.text: So what did you wanna ask about?

say:7:1310508006:0.text: Hmm, I've seen one around here. Let me think...
say:7:1310508006:0.source_cn: 七瓣蓝绒花啊，对，我倒是在这里见过好几次。让我想想……

say:8:1310508007:0.text: Right! I saw it in the <style="highlight">Stoneheart Wastes</style> nearby!
say:8:1310508007:0.source_cn: 是了，那几次我都是在花海的<style=highlig...

say:9:1310508008:0.text: It began in the past few months. People claim that the "true god" personally answers their prayers...
say:9:1310508008:0.source_cn: 我就是近三四个月才听说的，那些人说什么真神会亲自回应信...

say:10:1310508009:0.text: But I swear upon Dura, my ancestors have lived in Whiteridge for generations, and I've never heard of such a god!
say:10:1310508009:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我祖祖辈辈住在白山，可从没听过这么个神！

say:11:1310508010:0.text: Hold on! You're this year's Chosen One, right? You certainly do look the part. Just head south, there are more ruins that way, it'll be easier to find a seven-petaled flower.
say:11:1310508010:0.source_cn: 哎呀，我知道了，你是今年的“受选者”吧！不错，看上去就...
say:11:1310508010:0.male: Hold on! You're this year's Chosen One, right? You certainly do look the part. Just head south, there are more ruins that way, it'll be easier to find a seven-petaled flower.
say:11:1310508010:0.female: Hold on! You're this year's Chosen One, right? You certainly do look the part. Just head south, there are more ruins that way, it'll be easier to find a seven-petaled flower.

say:13:1310508011:0.text: Are there many ruins around here?
say:13:1310508011:0.source_cn: 这一带有很多古代的遗迹吗？

say:14:1310508012:0.text: Yes. This place was a battlefield during the Divine War. It may not have been the most intense area, but many warriors fell here.
say:14:1310508012:0.source_cn: 是啊！神魔战争那会儿，这里是战场。虽然不是打得最激烈的...

say:15:1310508013:0.text: The fortresses from that time have long collapsed, leaving only broken walls and rubble.
say:15:1310508013:0.source_cn: 当时的堡垒早都塌完了，就还剩些断壁碎石什么的。

say:16:1310508014:0.text: Just search the flower bushes by the ruins. With Dura's blessing, you'll definitely find it!
say:16:1310508014:0.source_cn: 你们就去遗迹附近的花丛里找，艾雅保佑，运气好的话肯定能...

say:18:1310508015:0.text: Wow, that's super helpful. Thank you!
say:18:1310508015:0.source_cn: 哇，这个消息太重要了，谢谢你！

say:0:1310509001:0.text: The Divine War must have been brutal...
say:0:1310509001:0.source_cn: 过去的神魔战争……一定很惨烈吧……

say:1:1310509002:0.text: Yeah, it seems like it left a huge mark on this place.
say:1:1310509002:0.source_cn: 嗯，似乎对这里的影响很大呢。

say:1:1310510001:1.source_cn: 到了到了，我们快找找看！

say:2:1310510002:1.text: Hey, Magister, what's that over there?
say:2:1310510002:1.source_cn: 来了！咦，主人，那……那是什么？
say:2:1310510002:1.male: Hey, Magister, what's that over there?
say:2:1310510002:1.female: Hey, Magister, what's that over there?

narration:4:1310510003:1.text: Suddenly, a flash of light reveals two children running through the ruins.

say:15:1310510007:1.text: M-Magister... was that just... an illusion?
say:15:1310510007:1.source_cn: 主人……主人，刚才那是……呃，幻觉？
say:15:1310510007:1.male: M-Magister... was that just... an illusion?
say:15:1310510007:1.female: M-Magister... was that just... an illusion?

choice_prompt:16:1310510007.text: M-Magister... was that just... an illusion?
choice_prompt:16:1310510007.source_cn: 主人……主人，刚才那是……呃，幻觉？
choice_prompt:16:1310510007.male: M-Magister... was that just... an illusion?
choice_prompt:16:1310510007.female: M-Magister... was that just... an illusion?

say:19:1310510009:0.text: Well, this place was a battlefield against the Hypogeans. The echoes of that war might still linger...
say:19:1310510009:0.source_cn: 毕竟这里曾经是和恶魔作战的地方，也许那场战争的影响至今...

say:20:1310510010:0.source_cn: 虽然只是要找七瓣蓝绒花，但我们还是小心谨慎一点吧！

say:22:1310510008:0.text: Could it be the vengeful souls of people who died during the war? That's terrifying!
say:22:1310510008:0.source_cn: 难道……难道是战争时死在这里的怨魂？噫，好可怕！

say:0:1310511001:0.text: Chippy hopes those kids managed to escape...
say:0:1310511001:0.source_cn: 希望那两个孩子能逃掉……好担心他们……

say:1:1310511002:0.text: Come on, don't get distracted! We still need to keep looking for the flower!
say:1:1310511002:0.source_cn: 满满，别走神呀，我们还得继续找花呢！

say:2:1310513001:1.text: Ah, it's those two kids again! And two warriors protecting them...
say:2:1310513001:1.source_cn: 呀，又是刚才那两个被怪物追逐的小孩子！还有两个战士在保...

say:3:1310513002:1.text: They really stood their ground against that Hypofiend. They were so brave.
say:3:1310513002:1.source_cn: 不知道后来怎么样了……他们面对恶魔也一步不退，很英勇。

say:4:1310513003:1.text: Chippy hopes those warriors rescued the kids, and that they all got out alive!
say:4:1310513003:1.source_cn: 要是战士们能从恶魔手中救出孩子就好了……嗯，他们自己也...

say:5:1310513004:1.text: The souls of many brave warriors must be here. Chippy hopes their spirits will guide us to the seven-petaled flower!
say:5:1310513004:1.source_cn: 满满知道这里有很多英勇战士的灵魂，希望你们的灵魂能指引...

say:6:1310513005:1.text: Then we'll offer the flower to the heroes of this war, to you all!
say:6:1310513005:1.source_cn: 我们会把七瓣花献给那场战争中的英雄——献给你们！

say:0:1310515001:0.text: Look, there are so many sapphirine blossoms here!
say:0:1310515001:0.source_cn: 看，这里有好多蓝绒花啊！
say:0:1310515001:0.male: Look, there are so many sapphirine blossoms here!
say:0:1310515001:0.female: Look, there are so many sapphirine blossoms here!

say:1:1310515002:0.text: With the protection of the warrior spirits, let's find the seven-petaled one!
say:1:1310515002:0.source_cn: 战士的英灵保佑，让我们找到七瓣的花吧！
say:1:1310515002:0.male: With the protection of the warrior spirits, let's find the seven-petaled one!
say:1:1310515002:0.female: With the protection of the warrior spirits, let's find the seven-petaled one!

say:1:1310516002:0.text: There are several swords here, but they're all super rusted.
say:1:1310516002:0.source_cn: 看！这里有好几把剑，可惜都锈的不成样子了。

say:3:1310519001:1.text: Hello, can you hear us? We're not Hypogeans, we're the good guys!
say:3:1310519001:1.source_cn: 喂，你们能听到我讲话吗？我们不是恶魔，也不是坏人！

say:4:1310519002:1.text: We saw everything! You saved those two children, you're heroes!
say:4:1310519002:1.source_cn: 我们都看到了，你们救了那两个小孩子，你们是英雄的战士！

say:10:1310519005:1.text: I see. These visions come from their powerful desires that linger here!
say:10:1310519005:1.source_cn: 我明白了，刚才看到的幻象就是他们强烈的执念所留存下来的！

say:11:1310519006:1.text: Even after all this time, they're still thinking about protecting those children...
say:11:1310519006:1.source_cn: 就算他们死去了那么久，也还想着要保护那些小孩子呢……

say:14:1310519009:1.source_cn: 死……我们……死了……？……我们……已经死了……

say:15:1310519010:1.text: War... did we win? What about the Hypogeans...?
say:15:1310519010:1.source_cn: 战争……胜利了吗？恶魔呢……恶魔……

say:16:1310519011:1.text: Don't worry, you won! The Hypogeans have been sealed away.
say:16:1310519011:1.source_cn: 放心吧，你们胜利了！恶魔也被封印起来了！

say:17:1310519012:1.text: And even though it's been two thousand years, the people here haven't forgotten you. They hold a grand festival every year to honor your sacrifice!
say:17:1310519012:1.source_cn: 而且就算过了两千年，这里的人们也没有忘记你们呢，他们每...

say:20:1310519013:1.text: Ah... we really won... we've fought... for too long...
say:20:1310519013:1.source_cn: 啊……胜利了……胜利了啊……我们等了……太久了……

say:23:1310519014:1.source_cn: 终于胜利了……终于……谢谢你们……

say:26:1310519007:1.text: Ah, they only appeared after Chippy touched those rusted swords. These must be the weapons they used back then...
say:26:1310519007:1.source_cn: 满满就摸了摸这些锈剑，他们就出现了，这肯定是他们当时用...

say:27:1310519008:1.text: They've been gone for so long, yet their desires are still so strong...
say:27:1310519008:1.source_cn: 他们死了那么久，执念依然好强大啊。

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 那些生锈的武器是触媒

say:0:1310520001:0.text: Chippy wonders where they're bringing us.

say:1:1310520002:0.text: Only one way to find out.
say:1:1310520002:0.male: Only one way to find out.
say:1:1310520002:0.female: Only one way to find out.

say:1:1310522001:0.text: These are the graves of the warriors who were lost in the war.
say:1:1310522001:0.source_cn: 原来是那些牺牲在恶魔战争中的战士的墓。

say:2:1310522002:1.text: The flowers here... they have a tragic beauty that surpasses the rest of the Floral Ruins.
say:2:1310522002:1.source_cn: 这里的鲜花……比花海其他地方都多了一份壮烈的美丽……

say:3:1310522003:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I understand now. Let's bury those rusted swords here.
say:3:1310522003:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I understand now. Let's bury those rusted swords here.
say:3:1310522003:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I understand now. Let's bury those rusted swords here.

say:4:1310522004:1.text: These soldiers must want to reunite with their comrades...
say:4:1310522004:1.source_cn: 对呀，那些士兵也一定很想和他们的战友重聚的……

say:1:1310523001:1.source_cn: 主人，埋葬这些锈剑的工作就交给满满吧！

say:5:1310523003:1.text: All the sapphirine blossoms here have seven petals!
say:5:1310523003:1.source_cn: 这里的蓝绒花……全都是七瓣的！

say:7:1310523004:1.text: Really? Remember what Her Highness said? The seven-petaled sapphirine blossom is a symbol of "miracles". They embody the will of ancient heroes.
say:7:1310523004:1.source_cn: 呀！真的！还记得公主殿下说的吗？“七瓣的蓝绒花是奇迹的...

say:8:1310523005:1.text: Maybe this is the soldiers' gift to us...
say:8:1310523005:1.source_cn: 或许这就是那些士兵给我们的谢礼吧……

say:0:1310524001:0.text: Since we've found the flower, let's head to the ceremony site.
say:0:1310524001:0.source_cn: 既然找到了七瓣的花，咱们这就去仪式会场吧！

say:0:1310524501:0.text: I remember Mr. Faramor saying we can reach it by heading east from here.
say:0:1310524501:0.source_cn: 我记得法拉莫尔先生说了，从这里往东，就能到点火仪式的会场。

say:0:1310525001:0.text: Wow, are all these people here to watch the ceremony?
say:0:1310525001:0.source_cn: 哇，这些都是去观看点火仪式的人吗？

say:0:1310527001:0.text: I can't believe the festival's over already... I haven't had enough fun yet...
say:0:1310527001:0.source_cn: 祭典结束了，我还没玩够呢……

say:2:1310528001:1.text: That fire earlier was incredible! You must be a talented mage!
say:2:1310528001:1.source_cn: 刚才那个点火的魔法真好看！你肯定是位特别出色的魔法师！
say:2:1310528001:1.male: That fire earlier was incredible! You must be a talented mage!
say:2:1310528001:1.female: That fire earlier was incredible! You must be a talented mage!

choice_prompt:3:1310528001.text: That fire earlier was incredible! You must be a talented mage!
choice_prompt:3:1310528001.source_cn: 刚才那个点火的魔法真好看！你肯定是位特别出色的魔法师！
choice_prompt:3:1310528001.male: That fire earlier was incredible! You must be a talented mage!
choice_prompt:3:1310528001.female: That fire earlier was incredible! You must be a talented mage!

say:4:1310528002:1.text: Oh, don't be so modest! Excessive humility can be a bit disingenuous, don't you think? Especially since you and Her Highness are such good friends. There's no need to play coy about your talents.
say:4:1310528002:1.source_cn: 您太谦虚了。要知道，过度的谦虚就成了虚伪，您和公主殿下...
say:4:1310528002:1.male: Oh, don't be so modest! Excessive humility can be a bit disingenuous, don't you think? Especially since you and Her Highness are such good friends. There's no need to play coy about your talents.
say:4:1310528002:1.female: Oh, don't be so modest! Excessive humility can be a bit disingenuous, don't you think? Especially since you and Her Highness are such good friends. There's no need to play coy about your talents.

say:5:1310528008:2.text: By the way, Your Highness, why place the hero's ice sculpture in such a remote spot? It's so far from town, people might find it hard to visit.
say:5:1310528008:2.source_cn: 对了，公主殿下，为什么要把英雄的冰雕立在这么偏僻的地方...

say:6:1310528009:1.text: Good question! I actually had that question myself, and I asked Father. He said...
say:6:1310528009:1.source_cn: 呀，真是不错的问题！我也问过父亲。

say:7:1310528010:1.text: The direction that ice sculpture faces used to be a battlefield during the Divine War. Now, it's a lake. It's said that many undead still roam those ruins today!
say:7:1310528010:1.source_cn: 你们看，冰雕面对的方向，虽然现在是片湖泊，可在过去，那...

say:8:1310528011:1.text: That's why the ice sculpture was placed here. The great general who defeated the Hypogeans can surely continue protecting us now, keeping the undead from harming anyone.
say:8:1310528011:1.source_cn: 所以我们才把冰雕立在靠近古战场的边界……战胜过恶魔和活...

say:9:1310528012:1.text: Wow! You guys must really admire this hero!
say:9:1310528012:1.source_cn: 原来如此，你们真的很崇敬这位英雄呢！

say:11:1310528013:1.text: Your Highness, we should head back to the castle.
say:11:1310528013:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，我们该启程回城堡了。

say:13:1310528014:1.text: Aww! The festival ended too soon... If only it could last longer, I could enjoy this for a whole month!
say:13:1310528014:1.source_cn: 真是的，祭典时间太短了……要是能持续下去，让我痛痛快快...

say:14:1310528015:1.text: By the way, would you all like to visit the castle? It's huge and beautiful. I could even show you a portrait I painted myself!
say:14:1310528015:1.source_cn: 对了，你们想不想来参观城堡？那里可大可漂亮了，我还能给...

say:17:1310528016:1.text: Thank you very much for the invitation, but we promised our friend General Hogan that we'd head back soon...
say:17:1310528016:1.source_cn: 谢谢您的邀请，可是我们答应了霍根将军，这次要早点回去……

say:18:1310528017:1.text: B-but... I'm the princess, I personally invited you! Surely I outrank some random general, right?
say:18:1310528017:1.source_cn: 但是……但是，你们得到了我的亲自邀约哦！公主比将军更厉...

say:20:1310528019:1.text: *Sigh* It's such a pity. I really wanted to spend more time with my new friends!
say:20:1310528019:1.source_cn: 好吧……真是太可惜了。我真的、真的很想和新朋友多相处一会儿。

say:21:1310528020:0.text: Oh, almost forgot! I've brought a gift for you. Please accept it.
say:21:1310528020:0.source_cn: 哎呀，差点忘了！这是我送你们的礼物，请收下吧！

say:23:1310528021:1.text: Wow! What cute snowmen! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look, we're all there!
say:23:1310528021:1.male: Wow! What cute snowmen! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look, we're all there!
say:23:1310528021:1.female: Wow! What cute snowmen! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look, we're all there!

say:26:1310528022:1.text: It's beautiful, Princess Yolena! You paint so well! Chippy will have the magister hang this painting in the center of our home!
say:26:1310528022:1.source_cn: 好漂亮！亚莲娜公主，你画得真好！满满回去要让主人把这幅...
say:26:1310528022:1.male: It's beautiful, Princess Yolena! You paint so well! Chippy will have the magister hang this painting in the center of our home!
say:26:1310528022:1.female: It's beautiful, Princess Yolena! You paint so well! Chippy will have the magister hang this painting in the center of our home!

choice_prompt:28:1310528022.text: It's beautiful, Princess Yolena! You paint so well! Chippy will have the magister hang this painting in the center of our home!
choice_prompt:28:1310528022.source_cn: 好漂亮！亚莲娜公主，你画得真好！满满回去要让主人把这幅画挂在屋子正中间！
choice_prompt:28:1310528022.male: It's beautiful, Princess Yolena! You paint so well! Chippy will have the magister hang this painting in the center of our home!
choice_prompt:28:1310528022.female: It's beautiful, Princess Yolena! You paint so well! Chippy will have the magister hang this painting in the center of our home!

say:29:1310528023:1.text: Then promise me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time you come to Whiteridge, you must come see me first!
say:29:1310528023:1.male: Then promise me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time you come to Whiteridge, you must come see me first!
say:29:1310528023:1.female: Then promise me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time you come to Whiteridge, you must come see me first!

choice_prompt:30:1310528023.text: Then promise me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time you come to Whiteridge, you must come see me first!
choice_prompt:30:1310528023.source_cn: 那，<style=stress><player_name></style>，答应我，下次来白山公国，一定要先来拜访我父亲和我！
choice_prompt:30:1310528023.male: Then promise me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time you come to Whiteridge, you must come see me first!
choice_prompt:30:1310528023.female: Then promise me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, next time you come to Whiteridge, you must come see me first!

say:31:1310528024:1.text: Goodbye, everyone! I hope to see you again soon!
say:31:1310528024:1.source_cn: 各位，再见啦！希望能早日再见！

say:35:1310528025:1.text: Are you departing from Whiteridge tomorrow?
say:35:1310528025:1.source_cn: 诸位，你们明天就要离开白山了吗？

say:38:1310528026:1.text: Yes. We'll rest at the hot springs inn tonight and set off at dawn. Mr. Faramor, what about you?
say:38:1310528026:1.source_cn: 嗯，是的。我们回温泉旅店休息一夜，天一亮就出发。法拉莫...

say:39:1310528027:1.text: As an undead hunter, I shall remain here a while longer. I intend to study them further and perhaps uncover a means to rid us of them entirely.
say:39:1310528027:1.source_cn: 漫漫女士，身为一名亡灵猎人，我打算在这里多留一段时间，...

say:40:1310528028:1.text: The hour grows late. I must take my leave and return to my cabin. It is some distance from here, and I fear I may not be able to bid you farewell in the morning.
say:40:1310528028:1.source_cn: 天色已晚，我也该回我的小屋了。那里离温泉旅店有些距离，...

say:41:1310528029:1.text: Allow me to offer my parting words now. May the goddess watch over you, and I wish you safe travels.
say:41:1310528029:1.source_cn: 请允许我提前与你们道别。愿众神保佑你们，祝你们明日一切顺利。

choice_prompt:42:1310528029.text: Allow me to offer my parting words now. May the goddess watch over you, and I wish you safe travels.
choice_prompt:42:1310528029.source_cn: 请允许我提前与你们道别。愿众神保佑你们，祝你们明日一切顺利。

say:45:1310528030:1.text: Thank you! We wish you all the best!
say:45:1310528030:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的祝福！漫漫、主人，当然还有我，也愿你一切顺利！
say:45:1310528030:1.male: Thank you! We wish you all the best!
say:45:1310528030:1.female: Thank you! We wish you all the best!

choice:42:1:2.text: Thank you, I hope we meet again.
choice:42:1:2.male: Thank you, I hope we meet again.
choice:42:1:2.female: Thank you, I hope we meet again.

choice:3:0:1.text: Oh, I just know a few tricks.
choice:3:0:1.male: Oh, I just know a few tricks.
choice:3:0:1.female: Oh, I just know a few tricks.

say:50:1310528003:1.text: Mhmm, you really do have a certain charm. It's quite nostalgic, actually. Reminds me of my time in the Lyceum. I had a friend there who was remarkable, like you.
say:50:1310528003:1.source_cn: 您可真是风度翩翩，这让我回忆起在莱希拉姆的时光了。我在...
say:50:1310528003:1.male: Mhmm, you really do have a certain charm. It's quite nostalgic, actually. Reminds me of my time in the Lyceum. I had a friend there who was remarkable, like you.
say:50:1310528003:1.female: Mhmm, you really do have a certain charm. It's quite nostalgic, actually. Reminds me of my time in the Lyceum. I had a friend there who was remarkable, like you.

say:51:1310528004:1.text: Seeing you stirs up old memories. It's a pity we've fallen out of touch, really... such a shame.
say:51:1310528004:1.source_cn: 看见您，总让我想起那位朋友。可惜，我们已经很久没有见过面了。
say:51:1310528004:1.male: Seeing you stirs up old memories. It's a pity we've fallen out of touch, really... such a shame.
say:51:1310528004:1.female: Seeing you stirs up old memories. It's a pity we've fallen out of touch, really... such a shame.

say:52:1310528005:1.text: Amazing! I'd love to see your magic again!
say:52:1310528005:1.source_cn: 哇，太棒了！我好想看你施展那种特别特别厉害的法术！
say:52:1310528005:1.male: Amazing! I'd love to see your magic again!
say:52:1310528005:1.female: Amazing! I'd love to see your magic again!

say:53:1310528006:1.text: Can you turn day into night? Or maybe pluck the stars from the sky and turn them into fireworks?
say:53:1310528006:1.source_cn: 你能把白昼变成黑夜吗？能摘下星星，再把它们变成烟火吗？
say:53:1310528006:1.male: Can you turn day into night? Or maybe pluck the stars from the sky and turn them into fireworks?
say:53:1310528006:1.female: Can you turn day into night? Or maybe pluck the stars from the sky and turn them into fireworks?

say:54:1310528007:1.text: Your Highness, don't worry, you'll witness it for sure. Isn't that right, "best mage ever"?
say:54:1310528007:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，放心，您一定能见识到的。我说的对吗，“最出色...
say:54:1310528007:1.male: Your Highness, don't worry, you'll witness it for sure. Isn't that right, "best mage ever"?
say:54:1310528007:1.female: Your Highness, don't worry, you'll witness it for sure. Isn't that right, "best mage ever"?

choice_prompt:56:1310528007.text: Your Highness, don't worry, you'll witness it for sure. Isn't that right, "best mage ever"?
choice_prompt:56:1310528007.source_cn: 公主殿下，放心，您一定能见识到的。我说的对吗，“最出色”的魔法师大人？
choice_prompt:56:1310528007.male: Your Highness, don't worry, you'll witness it for sure. Isn't that right, "best mage ever"?
choice_prompt:56:1310528007.female: Your Highness, don't worry, you'll witness it for sure. Isn't that right, "best mage ever"?

choice:56:0:1.text: Of course, if you wish it.
choice:56:0:1.male: Of course, if you wish it.
choice:56:0:1.female: Of course, if you wish it.

choice:3:2:3.text: Yes, I'm the best mage ever!
choice:3:2:3.source_cn: 不是特别出色，是最出色
choice:3:2:3.male: Yes, I'm the best mage ever!
choice:3:2:3.female: Yes, I'm the best mage ever!

say:2:1310529001:1.text: Oho, our Chosen One is back! Did you have fun?
say:2:1310529001:1.source_cn: 哇哦，我们的“受选者”回来了！怎么样，玩得开心吗？
say:2:1310529001:1.male: Oho, our Chosen One is back! Did you have fun?
say:2:1310529001:1.female: Oho, our Chosen One is back! Did you have fun?

say:3:1310529002:1.text: It was amazing! But Madam Gerda, you didn't even come to the lighting ceremony...
say:3:1310529002:1.source_cn: 很开心！可是格尔达女士，你都没有去看点火仪式呢……

say:4:1310529003:1.text: Sweetheart, I had to tidy up at the inn, you know.
say:4:1310529003:1.source_cn: 哈哈，亲爱的，你瞧，我可是得在旅店里做整理呢。

say:5:1310529004:1.text: Now that the festival's over, all those spooky decorations need to come down. We're expecting a lot of tourists for the hot spring tomorrow.
say:5:1310529004:1.source_cn: 祭典结束，那些用来吓人的装饰就得收拾起来了，明天肯定会...

say:7:1310529005:1.text: Oh no, my lovely Gerda, have you forgotten about me? You didn't even say my name! I've been darting around the inn all day, so much so that my poor ears are about to flop right off!
say:7:1310529005:1.source_cn: 哎呀，美丽的格尔达女士，你是把我忘了吗？居然没有提起我...

say:8:1310529006:1.text: Stop whining. I paid you, and I promised you a free hot spring bath, didn't I?
say:8:1310529006:1.source_cn: 别抱怨了，我可是付了工钱，还答应你免费泡温泉的！

say:12:1310529007:1.text: Ooh, just picturing it! Soaking in that hot spring, snow all around, sipping on some cold drinks... Ahh, I can already feel the warmth melting my bones. I could dive in right this second!
say:12:1310529007:1.source_cn: 啊，一想到泡在温泉里一边看着雪景、一边喝着冷饮，在温暖...

say:13:1310529008:1.text: But hey, what's the plan now for you guys? Now that the festival's wrapped up, what grand adventure's next?
say:13:1310529008:1.source_cn: 说起来，我亲爱的朋友们，祭典结束了，你们之后有什么打算？

say:16:1310529009:1.text: We're planning to head back to Holistone tomorrow morning!
say:16:1310529009:1.source_cn: 我们已经计划好了，明早就出发回圣石镇！

say:17:1310529010:1.text: What? Already? Come on, why not hang out a few more days? The food's fantastic, the views are even better. It'd be a shame to leave before soaking it all in!
say:17:1310529010:1.source_cn: 不再多玩几天了？这里的美食和风景都很出色，还是值得多停...

say:18:1310529011:1.text: Chippy wants to stay too! But we've been all over, from the Ashen Wastes to Rustport, and now here at Whiteridge. We haven't had a proper rest in ages! And the Magister's memory...
say:18:1310529011:1.source_cn: 啊……满满也很想玩。可这段时间我们一直在东跑西跑，从荒...
say:18:1310529011:1.male: Chippy wants to stay too! But we've been all over, from the Ashen Wastes to Rustport, and now here at Whiteridge. We haven't had a proper rest in ages! And the Magister's memory...
say:18:1310529011:1.female: Chippy wants to stay too! But we've been all over, from the Ashen Wastes to Rustport, and now here at Whiteridge. We haven't had a proper rest in ages! And the Magister's memory...

choice_prompt:19:1310529011.text: Chippy wants to stay too! But we've been all over, from the Ashen Wastes to Rustport, and now here at Whiteridge. We haven't had a proper rest in ages! And the Magister's memory...
choice_prompt:19:1310529011.source_cn: 啊……满满也很想玩。可这段时间我们一直在东跑西跑，从荒角沙漠到锈锚港，又来到白山，都没有好好休息过，主人的记忆力都累得变差了！
choice_prompt:19:1310529011.male: Chippy wants to stay too! But we've been all over, from the Ashen Wastes to Rustport, and now here at Whiteridge. We haven't had a proper rest in ages! And the Magister's memory...
choice_prompt:19:1310529011.female: Chippy wants to stay too! But we've been all over, from the Ashen Wastes to Rustport, and now here at Whiteridge. We haven't had a proper rest in ages! And the Magister's memory...

say:20:1310529012:1.text: Haha! Memory issues, huh? I might have to borrow that excuse for the next time I ask the innkeeper for a day off.
say:20:1310529012:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈……“累得记忆力变差”？这个理由可真不错，下次我...

say:21:1310529013:1.text: With all the things you've been through, I don't even know if I should call it good luck or bad luck.
say:21:1310529013:1.source_cn: 这么想想，你们一路上碰到那么多事情，真不知道运气该算是...

say:22:1310529015:1.text: What about you, Lorsan? Planning to stick around?
say:22:1310529015:1.source_cn: 你要在这里多留一段时间吗，洛桑？

say:23:1310529016:1.text: Oh, me? I'm stuck here for another two weeks, thanks to my deal with Madam Gerda. Gotta finish my work before I hit the road next month.
say:23:1310529016:1.source_cn: 我嘛，按照和美丽的格尔达女士的约定，还得在这里工作半个...

say:24:1310529017:1.text: Seems like destiny's making us part ways again. But don't worry, I'll go with you to Cedartown tomorrow. We'll find a nice carriage to take you back from there.
say:24:1310529017:1.source_cn: 看来自然的意志要将我们分开了。我的朋友们，明早我陪你们...

say:27:1310529018:1.text: Dearies, your rooms are all set up! Go on and get some rest.
say:27:1310529018:1.source_cn: 亲爱的，你们的房间已经准备好了，快去休息吧。

say:28:1310529019:1.text: If you're feeling super worn out, hit the hot spring first. Let all that tension melt away, then drift right into that cozy bed.
say:28:1310529019:1.source_cn: 要是太累的话，也可以先去泡会温泉，彻底放松，再舒舒服服...

say:29:1310529020:1.text: That sounds amazing! Chippy's already dreaming of that soft, snuggly bed!
say:29:1310529020:1.source_cn: 太棒了！我已经开始想念又软又舒服的床了！

say:31:1310529014:1.text: Chippy didn't mean that... Anyway, you really could use a good rest!
say:31:1310529014:1.source_cn: 我就是那么说说而已……总之，主人应该好好休息一阵子才对！
say:31:1310529014:1.male: Chippy didn't mean that... Anyway, you really could use a good rest!
say:31:1310529014:1.female: Chippy didn't mean that... Anyway, you really could use a good rest!

choice:19:1:2.text: Not like it could get worse...
choice:19:1:2.male: Not like it could get worse...
choice:19:1:2.female: Not like it could get worse...

narration:0:1310601001:1.text: After a peaceful night's sleep in the cozy guest room, a new day begins.

say:0:1310602001:0.text: *Yawn* Chippy slept like a log! Mhmm, amazing.
say:0:1310602001:0.source_cn: 呵欠……睡得真舒服呀，满满觉得自己浑身充满了力量！

say:1:1310602002:0.text: Let's head out! Lorsan's probably waiting for us.
say:1:1310602002:0.source_cn: 咱们出去吧！洛桑一定在外面等我们了。

say:4:1310526001:0.text: You're back! You must've found the seven-petaled flower, right?
say:4:1310526001:0.source_cn: 你们回来了！找到七瓣蓝绒花了吗？哎，先让我猜猜看，一定...

say:7:1310526003:0.text: Since everything's ready, let's begin the ceremony!
say:7:1310526003:0.source_cn: 既然都准备好了，那么就开始点火仪式吧。

narration:9:1310526004:1.text: The Archduke of Whiteridge steps towards the statue, and the crowd quiets down.

say:10:1310526005:0.text: Ladies and gentlemen, before us stands a sculpture, not merely of ice, but of valor itself. It is a testament to courage, a monument to our eternal protector!
say:10:1310526005:0.source_cn: 各位，这座矗立在我们面前的雕像，是勇气的证明，是守护者...

say:11:1310526006:0.text: This hero, a general from the Divine War, shall forever remain vigilant, guarding our people from the horrors of Hypogeans and undead alike.
say:11:1310526006:0.source_cn: 这位在神魔战争中的英雄将领，她会始终屹立在这里，守护白...

say:12:1310526007:0.text: Now, with reverence in our hearts, we call the Chosen One to offer the sacred seven-petaled sapphirine blossom to the hero!
say:12:1310526007:0.source_cn: 现在，我们心怀敬意，请“受选者”为英雄献上七瓣蓝绒花！
say:12:1310526007:0.male: Now, with reverence in our hearts, we call the Chosen One to offer the sacred seven-petaled sapphirine blossom to the hero!
say:12:1310526007:0.female: Now, with reverence in our hearts, we call the Chosen One to offer the sacred seven-petaled sapphirine blossom to the hero!

narration:17:13010533:0.text: The lighting ceremony is all set, and the hero sculpture is ready for its official unveiling.
narration:17:13010533:0.source_cn: 点火仪式的现场已经做好了准备，英雄冰雕也等待着正式的揭幕。

narration:18:13010533:0.text: The lighting ceremony is all set, and the hero sculpture is ready for its official unveiling.
narration:18:13010533:0.source_cn: 点火仪式的现场已经做好了准备，英雄冰雕也等待着正式的揭幕。
